title: Make a lei and learn hula on Maui
description: Makoa Quest’s cultural experience brings you together with a local guide to make a lei and learn about hula. Work with the flowers and leaves in your hands, then follow the movements and stories behind the dance. The session offers a slower way to meet Hawaiian traditions than watching a performance from a distance.
teaser: Learn the gestures and care behind a Maui lei.
goodToKnow: Confirm the class format and accessibility. You can ask whether the hula portion is optional.
whyItMightDelightYou: Making something with a teacher can open a more personal conversation about place and tradition.
